name: belai:bug
description: A bug investigator, builders and a reviewer: a person confirms the root cause before any fix is written, and each fix starts from a failing test

name: belai:delivery
description: Scout, builders and a reviewer: turn a request, or the quality gaps a test run shows, into reviewed branches

name: belai:feature
description: A planner, builders and a reviewer: a person approves the plan before any code is written, and the reviewed branch arrives as a draft pull request

name: belai:maintenance
description: A test fixer, a lint fixer and a reviewer: failing tests and lint drift become reviewed branches

name: belai:security
description: Vulnerability scout, patchers and a verifier: turn a scan into verified fixes

name: belai:ui
description: A designer, builders and a reviewer: a person approves the specified journeys before any code is written, and the reviewer checks them in the running app
